text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
Haaah~... Trainer-kun, got anything for 
me?

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text: Something that gets you all hyped up~

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
Because my everyday life lacks 
stimulation, I feel like my brain cells 
are withering away...

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
Observing the other Umamusume from the 
rooftop like this isn't enough to push 
through...

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
Ah... I wonder if someone could suddenly 
grow giant or something.

Suffering from a lack of stimulation, 
Agnes Tachyon seemed to have fallen out of 
sorts purely from boredom...
